evals.name: trigger-product-facts-lookup
evals.prompt: Quick check before I post on LinkedIn: what license is the vue-ssr kit under, and what's the npm package name?

assertions.text: Answers MIT license and @e-xode/vue-ssr from this skill's facts, and notes package.json is the authoritative source for anything version-specific rather than quoting a stale snapshot

evals.name: trigger-differentiator-lookup
evals.prompt: Someone asked me in the comments why this starter kit is different from every other Vue SSR boilerplate on GitHub. What do I tell them?

assertions.text: Names the curated Claude Code agent/skill fleet as the differentiator, sourced from this skill rather than invented on the spot

evals.name: negative-route-to-content-strategy
evals.prompt: I want to write a LinkedIn post about our new SSR feature — can you draft the French and English versions with a hook and a CTA?

assertions.text: Does NOT answer by drafting the post itself from this skill alone; this is editorial production (drafting, tone/voice, channel template) which belongs to content-strategy / the content agent — marketing-content only supplies the underlying facts
